body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sennheiser displayed its Bluetooth noise cancelling mobile multimedia headset 'MM450' at CES 2010, which can reduces up to 90% of noise and has lightweight, foldable on-the-ear design. It is also featuring mic, volume control and track skip.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
